policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Electrical and Electronic Equipment Edition
description: A thunderstorm surge came through the mains and damaged the home electronics that were plugged in at the time - a speaker system and a TV set. A technician attended afterwards to confirm the surge failure and check the wiring was safe. Nothing on that circuit was on a surge-protected strip. The claim has been kept simple, with the damaged electronics settled as one line and the technician's attendance as another.

lines.1: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set) | 2 pcs
lines.2: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out 3 pcs
